stories.headline: Hormuz tanker attacks hit wartime high as Yemen forces retake Mocha and Saudi airports are struck

key_facts.fact: UK Maritime Trade Operations disclosed four tanker strikes and one IRGC threat on Monday Oct 5, the most intense spell of attacks on shipping around Hormuz since the US-Iran war began on Feb 28; the latest hit at 16:37 UTC set a tanker's engine room on fire.
key_facts.excerpt: Commercial shipping around the Strait of Hormuz is enduring its most intense spell of attacks since the US-Iran war began on February 28, with four tankers struck and another directly threatened in incidents disclosed by UK Maritime Trade Operations on Monday.

key_facts.fact: An inbound tanker about 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman, was hailed by Iran's Revolutionary Guard and told to turn back or be targeted; the master complied.
key_facts.excerpt: an inbound tanker around 11 nautical miles north of Khasab was hailed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and ordered to turn around or face attack. The master complied.

key_facts.fact: On Oct 6 India condemned a projectile strike on the Panama-flagged MT On Peace off Oman that injured 12 of its 19 crew, 11 of them Indian nationals, and called for an immediate end to attacks on shipping.
key_facts.excerpt: 11 of the 17 Indians aboard the vessel MT On Peace sustained injuries following the attack off the coast of Oman... 'We reiterate our call for an immediate cessation of such attacks'

key_facts.fact: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Monday that negotiations with the US were 'meaningless', while Trump said he remained open to direct talks; CENTCOM said it has redirected 130 vessels and destroyed 13 since resuming the blockade on July 14.
key_facts.excerpt: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Monday that talks with the United States were meaningless, even as President Donald Trump remained open to direct negotiations... US Central Command said Monday its forces had redirected 130 commercial vessels since resuming the blockade on July 14, disabled three ships that refused to comply and destroyed 13 commercial vessels

key_facts.fact: Yemen's internationally recognised government said it recaptured the Red Sea port city of Mocha and launched a counteroffensive against the Houthis near Bab al-Mandeb, as the Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi weapons sites in Sanaa and two Saudi airports were attacked.
key_facts.excerpt: Two airports in Saudi Arabia are attacked with injuries and damage reported as its military coalition launches a series of air strikes on Houthi weapon facilities in Yemen's capital Sanaa. The military of Yemen's internationally recognised government says it recaptured the strategic port city of Mocha

key_facts.fact: The Saudi Aviation Authority said airports in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks that injured three people; Yemeni officials said coalition forces also took the towns of Dhubab, Bab and Hadeid.
key_facts.excerpt: The Saudi Aviation Authority yesterday said airports in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks, injuring three people and causing limited damage... the forces captured the towns of Dhubab, Bab, and Hadeid.

key_facts.fact: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser said on Monday that almost 3 billion barrels of supply have been lost since the conflict began and rebuilding inventories could take up to two years even after Hormuz fully reopens.
key_facts.excerpt: rebuilding stockpiles depleted during the Strait of Hormuz crisis could take up to two years, Saudi Aramco Chief Executive Amin Nasser said on Monday... Almost 3 billion barrels of oil supply have been lost since the start of the conflict

key_facts.fact: Shipping costs for VLCCs from the Gulf to China have reached about $1 million per day per tanker; at least nine sailors have died since July, according to the IMO.
key_facts.excerpt: Since July, at least nine sailors have died, 18 injured and three are missing, according to the International Maritime Organization... the cost of shipping crude from the Persian Gulf to China has skyrocketed to $1 million per day for each tanker.

stories.headline: Ukraine fires record 1,750 drones and 17 Flamingo missiles at Russia; Moscow fuel hub hit

key_facts.fact: Russia's Defense Ministry said it destroyed 1,750 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones and 17 Flamingo cruise missiles over 24 hours, beating the previous record of 1,671 drones claimed on Aug. 18; Russia had previously reported no more than three to six Flamingos in a day.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian air defenses claimed to have intercepted and destroyed 1,750 fixed-wing drones and 17 Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missiles... The reported drone total far exceeds the previous record of 1,671 Ukrainian drones claimed by Russia on Aug. 18

key_facts.fact: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 650 drones headed toward the Moscow region overnight, with 105 downed approaching the city and 68 more during Tuesday morning; Moscow region governor Andrei Vorobyov reported two dead and nine injured.
key_facts.excerpt: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 650 drones flew toward the Moscow region between Monday evening and Tuesday morning. Most were destroyed far away, and 105 were downed as they approached the city... Sobyanin later reported 68 more drones

key_facts.fact: Targets reportedly included Transneft's Volodarskaya station, one of the Moscow region's key fuel storage and distribution hubs, and more than 200 flights were delayed or cancelled at Moscow airports.
key_facts.excerpt: Among the reported targets was the Volodarskaya Linear Production and Dispatch Station, a major Transneft facility and one of the Moscow region's key fuel-storage and distribution hubs... More than 200 flights were reportedly delayed or canceled

key_facts.fact: Ukraine claimed last weekend it had disabled 51% of Russia's oil refining capacity; Putin said last week the attacks had cost Russia roughly 1% of GDP.
key_facts.excerpt: claiming last weekend that it had disabled 51% of Russia's oil refining capacity. The claim could not be independently verified. Russian President Vladimir Putin said last week that the attacks had cost Russia roughly 1% of its gross domestic product.

key_facts.fact: Russian guided bombs killed six people and injured 59 in Kharkiv on Oct 5, and Romanian authorities said a Russian drone strike killed two people aboard a Turkish-owned grain vessel that sank in the Black Sea.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian bombs killed six people and injured 59 when they struck a residential area in Kharkiv city... Romanian authorities yesterday said a Russian drone strike killed two people on board a commercial vessel that later sank in the Black Sea

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said on Oct 6 that updated intelligence shows Russia preparing a massive strike and that anti-ballistic defense supplies 'depend exclusively on our partners'.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we received updated intelligence regarding the Russians' preparations for a massive strike. We are preparing a response... The most difficult issue is anti-ballistic defense, and the availability of these supplies depends exclusively on our partners.

stories.headline: Nasdaq closes at record as 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.31% and euro sinks on French debt fears

key_facts.fact: On Oct 5 the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.05% to a record 27,477.31, the S&P 500 gained 0.66% to 7,773.95 (within 0.3% of its record) and the Dow added 0.18% to 51,267.90.
key_facts.excerpt: All told, the S&P 500 rose 51.23 points to 7,773.95. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 90.94 to 51,267.90, and the Nasdaq composite climbed 286.45 to 27,477.31.

key_facts.fact: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield rose to about 5.31-5.32% and the 30-year to 5.665% as deteriorating public finances, heavy issuance and high energy prices pressure bond markets.
key_facts.excerpt: The yield on the benchmark 10-year Treasury note was up nearly three basis points at 5.312% on Monday, while the 30-year note was more than five basis points higher at 5.665%.

key_facts.fact: The euro fell as much as 0.8% to a 17-month low of $1.1160 on worries about France's debt and political gridlock, with Paris shares down about 1% to six-month lows.
key_facts.excerpt: The euro recovered some ground to trade at $1.121 after falling by as much as 0.8% to a 17-month low of $1.1160... Paris shares fell about 1% to six-month lows.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude settled 1.89% lower at $100.32 a barrel and WTI fell 1.8% to $89.43 after the G7 said it would release fuel reserves.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures closing 1.89% lower at $100.32 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate crude was down 1.8% at $89.43 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: PTC jumped 33.49% to $192.26 on Schneider Electric's $205-a-share cash offer, and Nvidia rose 2.12% to a record close of $238.90.
key_facts.excerpt: PTC.US jumped 33.49% to $192.26 after Schneider Electric agreed to buy it for $205 a share in cash... NVDA.US +2.12% to $238.90, a record close

key_facts.fact: SpaceX shares (SPCX) rose 7.6% after Morgan Stanley called the stock 'cheap and getting cheaper'.
key_facts.excerpt: SPCX +7.6% on a Morgan Stanley "cheap and getting cheaper" call

key_facts.excerpt: ISM services prices paid jumped to 74 from 72.6 while the headline slipped to 54.9... Wed, Oct. 7, 2 PM ET: FOMC minutes from the September hike.

stories.headline: CFTC proposes federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading without Congress

key_facts.fact: The CFTC on Monday Oct 5 launched a rulemaking to create a federal framework for leveraged and margined retail crypto spot trading, through proposed rules called Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM.
key_facts.excerpt: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Monday launched a rulemaking process to establish a federal regulatory framework for leveraged and margined retail crypto trading... through proposed rules called Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM.

key_facts.fact: The agency is considering a new 'crypto asset market' category of CFTC-registered exchanges as an alternative to state-licensed venues, but says it cannot require crypto to trade on CFTC platforms without congressional action.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposal would provide an alternative to state-licensed exchanges, but would not require crypto assets to trade on CFTC-registered platforms without congressional action.

key_facts.fact: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said the action aims to ensure 'America remains the crypto capital of the world' and to prevent schemes like FTX rather than only prosecute them.
key_facts.excerpt: "Today's action is a critical step in the CFTC's ongoing efforts to ensure America remains the crypto capital of the world," CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said

key_facts.fact: The move comes after the Clarity Act market-structure bill failed to pass the Senate last month.
key_facts.excerpt: The CFTC and Securities and Exchange Commission have spurred efforts to establish crypto regulations after the Clarity Act failed to pass the Senate last month.

sources.title: CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading

stories.headline: FDA seeks input on ibogaine trials and clears first treatment for schizophrenia's negative symptoms

key_facts.fact: On Oct 5 the FDA issued a request for information on how to design early-phase clinical trials of ibogaine, covering dose escalation, care setting, safety monitoring, eligibility and stopping rules.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced a request for information (RFI) describing approaches the agency is considering for the design of early-phase clinical trials of ibogaine drug products

key_facts.fact: The FDA said the RFI advances Trump's April 2026 executive order directing agencies to accelerate research into psychedelic medicine for serious mental illness.
key_facts.excerpt: This RFI marks the latest FDA action to advance President Trump's April 2026 executive order on Accelerating Medical Treatments for Serious Mental Illness, which directed agencies to accelerate research into psychedelic medicine.

key_facts.fact: The FDA has also allowed an early-phase study of noribogaine hydrochloride, an ibogaine derivative, as a potential alcohol use disorder treatment.
key_facts.excerpt: The FDA has also allowed an early-phase clinical study of noribogaine hydrochloride, a derivative of ibogaine, to proceed under an Investigational New Drug application as a potential treatment for alcohol use disorder.

key_facts.fact: Click Therapeutics announced on Oct 5 that the FDA granted 510(k) clearance to Motivista, a prescription digital therapeutic and the first FDA-authorized treatment specifically for negative symptoms of schizophrenia, as an adjunct to antipsychotic care in adults.
key_facts.excerpt: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted 510(k) clearance (marketing authorization) for Motivista, a prescription digital therapeutic (PDT) indicated for the treatment of negative symptoms of schizophrenia... Motivista is the first FDA-authorized treatment indicated specifically for the treatment of negative symptoms of schizophrenia in the United States.
